description.value: The BEST WESTERN Cranbrook Hotel is a franchise hotel property located on Cranbrook Street North in Cranbrook, a regional hub in BC's East Kootenay. Cranbrook serves as a common overnight stop for cyclists riding the Rocky Mountain routes and Kootenay region touring loops. As a full-service hotel brand, it offers a predictable baseline of amenities for travellers arriving by any means.
